output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is that the vulnerability allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, causing a denial of service to the user.
The transfer function has a wrong logic in it, allowing users to transfer tokens to 0x0 address, causing loss of funds.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is that if the allowance is large, and the balance of the user is also large, it can result in a large positive number, causing a denial of service to the user.
